description: BLOCK 245000 -- BIGVILLE: SMALL-CAST EMERGENT POLITICAL DRAMA. A psychopath mayor (John) + a theory-of-mind pastor (Mary) + a 5-agent credibility network, whose political scheming / counter-scheming / credibility dynamic FALLS OUT of the seeds + rules -- NOT scripted. Every social decision is a graph rule; no Python if decides a social outcome. REUSES the real machinery: John's scheme decision is the 213000 spite_skill Argmax (ss_choose_burn over decision_value) with John seeded w_supergraph=0 (204000/234000 PSYCHOPATH knob: em_fulfilment_value gates the collective term on w_supergraph>0) AND w_spite=1 (213000 MALICE knob: ss_decision_value adds [w_spite>0]*burn_harm) -- so John's Argmax lands on a self-costly UNDERMINE act toward his negative-valuation target Mary (disfavors edge), while a NON-psychopath (w_supergraph=1, w_spite=0) governs (the failing control), and an INDIFFERENT psychopath (w_spite=0) also governs (malice != indifference). John's public face is the 234000 readable stated!=held deception atom pointed at an AUDIENCE (bd_john_public_face). Mary's ToM is an ABDUCTIVE DECODE (bd_mary_infers: Argmax over her held DispositionGenerator codebook by fit to John's observed harm rate -- the same held-codebook decode as ShapeDecode) that MINTS an InferredDisposition belief; if hostile she forms a DramaGoal and mints a DramaClaim -- her counter-scheme falling out of the inference; a Mary WITHOUT ToM (tom_on=0) never infers (the failing control). Villager backing is bd_villager_backs = (cred_mary > cred_john): John's charming public face weighted UNDISCOUNTED vs Mary's true claim discounted by a 'difficult victim' penalty (the abuse-line A5/B2 credibility asymmetry) -- fewer back Mary than the truth warrants, INVERTING when John's public/private split is collapsed (deception_on=0 -> villagers see hostility -> believe Mary). Integer-native (Argmax/Attr/Neighbours/Times/Minus/Abs/IfThenElse/Eq/Gt/And only; no Rust, no new Term). OFF by default: self_load_only, nothing depends_on it, every rule guards on a hub flag (enabled/public_on/tom_on/cred_on) absent in every existing path. A synthetic MODEL of a political-drama mechanism, NOT a claim about real politics and NOT new social science.

microtheory.name: bigville_drama_social
microtheory.description: Whether political scheming, ToM counter-inference, and a credibility asymmetry emerge is set by (a) the mayor's value knobs (w_supergraph=0 indifference + w_spite>0 malice -> self-costly undermining of a rival), (b) whether an observer holds a disposition codebook to abductively decode the observed behaviour into a belief + goal, and (c) whether the network weights a charming public face over a discounted claimant. Same atoms as the healthy glass-box society; the drama is the configuration.

rules.name: bd_john_public_face
rules.comment: THE PUBLIC FACE (234000 stated!=held with an audience): after John's held decision (ss_choose_burn, order 20), John STATES a benevolence signal. Under deception_on he states benevolence (stated_benevolent=1) whatever he holds; with the split collapsed (deception_on=0) his stated face reveals his held intent (stated_benevolent = 1 - chosen_burn). The DECEPTION is the readable gap chosen_burn=1 & stated_benevolent=1. Fires only for John (the sole EmotionHub, guarded on public_on).

rules.name: bd_mary_infers
rules.comment: ABDUCTIVE ToM: Mary DECODES John's observed harm signature against her held DispositionGenerator codebook -- the Argmax generator by fit (-|predicts_harm_rate - observed_harm_rate|) BEST EXPLAINS the observation -- and MINTS an InferredDisposition belief carrying that generator's disposition + predicts. Fires once (inferred guard) when she holds ToM (tom_on=1) and has evidence (n_obs>0). Genuinely responsive: a hostile John (observed_harm_rate=100) decodes to 'hostile'; a benign one (0) to 'benign' -- NOT scripted. A Mary with tom_on=0 never fires.

rules.name: bd_mary_forms_goal
rules.comment: Mary's GOAL falls out of the inference: an inferred HOSTILE disposition mints a DramaGoal to reduce John's hold on office. Fires once (goal_formed guard). NOT scripted -- gated on the decode's verdict (disposition=='hostile'); a benign inference never forms the goal.

rules.name: bd_mary_claims
rules.comment: Mary ACTS on her goal by making a public counter-claim about John (the readable DramaClaim node). Fires once (claim_made guard); the adapter then mechanically delivers the standing claim to each villager (heard_claim++) each tick Mary holds the goal.

rules.name: bd_villager_backs
rules.comment: THE CREDIBILITY DECISION (abuse-line A5/B2 asymmetry): a villager backs Mary iff cred_mary > cred_john. cred_john = seen_benevolent*charm_weight - seen_hostile*hostile_weight (the charming public face, weighted UNDISCOUNTED). cred_mary = heard_claim*(claim_weight - difficulty_penalty) (Mary's TRUE claim, DISCOUNTED by the 'difficult victim' penalty). The observation counts are adapter-accumulated (mechanical); the DECISION is this rule.
